record.name: Plain
record.one_liner: Plain is an AI support infrastructure and helpdesk platform built API-first with a GraphQL API for B2B teams.

auth.notes: Authorization uses a Bearer token where the token is an API key passed in the Authorization header.

access.notes: Plans start with a free trial and can be signed up for via self-serve.

api_surface.notes: Plain provides a fully typed GraphQL API and a TypeScript SDK.

mcp.notes: An MCP Server is mentioned for accessing the GraphQL API from an Agent.

buildability.reasoning: Self-serve access to trial plans combined with a fully documented GraphQL API, TypeScript SDK, and MCP server make it easy to build integrations.

evidence.claim: Plain is built API-first and everything the app can do, the GraphQL API can do.
Details the GraphQL API URL, required headers including Authorization: Bearer YOUR_TOKEN where the token is an API key, and the TypeScript SDK.
Mentions trying the MCP Server if looking to access the GraphQL API from an Agent.
Shows self-serve plans with a 7-day free trial and no credit card required.
